name: Upper valve cover with COP towers, F0 AlSi10Mg concept
description: Independent concept of a 993 upper valve cover, open on the oil side, with six fins and three integrated coil-on-plug towers. The sources confirm billet alternatives and interest in COP, but no individual geometry; all F0 interfaces are synthetic.

classification.intended_use: F0 screening of open CAD, COP consolidation, crankcase pressure, clamping, flatness, thermal, convection and mass; no manufacturing, sealing, installation or start-up authorized

provenance.record_license: MIT for the concept, the script and the calculations; no Porsche/FVD/Protomotive/BBi/EOS photograph, surface or commercial geometry redistributed

sources.title: PorscheFanatics - 993 valve covers and coil-on-plug integration
sources.notes: Catalogs aluminum alternatives and identifies a BBi kit carrying the COP coils; no geometry or LPBF evidence. See SRC-PORSCHEFANATICS-993-VALVE-COVER-CANDIDATE.

sources.title: FVD - complete set of 993 billet valve covers
sources.notes: Declares billet aluminum, a four-cover kit, 400 x 150 x 200 mm and 3.32 kg; values for the complete kit only. See SRC-FVD-993-BILLET-VALVE-COVER-SET.

sources.title: Protomotive - 993 upper valve covers in 6061-T6
sources.notes: Confirms a Carrera/Turbo upper pair, CAD, 6061-T6 billet machining and anodizing; no individual definition. See SRC-PROTOMOTIVE-993-UPPER-VALVE-COVER-6061.

sources.title: PorscheFanatics - 993 tightening torques
sources.notes: Unverified OCR transcription: cover on camshaft housing, M6, 9.7 Nm, page 60. Used as a scenario, never as an instruction. See SRC-PORSCHEFANATICS-993-TORQUES.

sources.title: EOS Aluminium AlSi10Mg material data sheet
sources.notes: T6 route and candidate material; numerical design values kept as generic project comparisons. See SRC-EOS-ALSI10MG-CURRENT-PAGE.

material.grade: EOS Aluminium AlSi10Mg T6, for comparison; commercial products in billet aluminum/6061-T6
material.standard: DIN EN 1706 EN AC-43000 and ASTM F3318 for the candidate; program-specific sealing/flatness specification to be contracted

post_processing: open orientation, supports and recoater strategy to be qualified
stress relief then T6 with controlled quench and distortion
HIP to be decided on porosity, sealing, fatigue and leak results
machining of the gasket face, holes, COP towers, vents and datums
deburring and oil-side finishing without retention of powder or media
anodizing compatible with oil, temperature, gaskets and coils
supplier_requirements: traceable machine, parameters, orientation, supports, powder and lot
oriented coupons with tensile, fatigue, creep, oil and hot corrosion
flatness and distortion witnesses after T6 and machining
full CT, FPI and metallography with zoned defect criteria
metrology of gasket face, bolt pattern, COP towers, vents and clearances
pressure, leak, thermal cycling, vibration and engine endurance proof

titanium.galvanic_isolation: Qualify AlSi10Mg against case, studs, nuts, coils, gaskets and oil; address corrosion, fretting and differential expansion.

known_limits: The 400 x 150 x 200 mm envelope and 3.32 kg concern a kit of four covers with gaskets/hardware, not the F0 part.
The 220 x 95 x 45 mm shell, the ten fasteners, six fins and three COP towers are entirely synthetic.
The 9.7 Nm torque comes from an unverified OCR transcription and constitutes no fitting instruction.
The AlSi10Mg values are generic comparisons, not a hot allowables map for a sealing face.
The pressures, temperatures, gradient, convection, heat and gasket are regression inputs.
The thermal stress, warpage and convection screens fail; no sealing is demonstrated.
No gasket contact, CHT, modal, fatigue, clamp-load relaxation or coil/harness integration is validated.
The STEP proves only a readable open BREP and is authorized neither for manufacturing, nor for sealing, nor for an engine.
